test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the total worth of the Urban Challenge Fund (UCF) announced in the Union Budget 2025–26 to encourage innovative urban development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Urban Challenge Fund (UCF)** was announced in the **Union Budget 2025–26** to promote innovative solutions for urban development.
 
• The total worth of the fund is **₹1 lakh crore**, which is aimed at addressing challenges in urban planning and infrastructure. *Hence, the correct option is ₹1 lakh crore.*
 
• The fund seeks to incentivize states and urban local bodies to adopt **modern urban planning**, improve infrastructure, and ensure sustainable development.
 
• This initiative aligns with the government’s vision of creating **smart cities** and ensuring that urban areas are equipped to handle challenges such as growing populations, traffic congestion, and climate change.
 
• The fund also encourages the adoption of **technology-driven solutions** to enhance urban governance and service delivery. *Hence, this fund is a significant step toward comprehensive urban development.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Urban Challenge Fund (UCF):**

 
 
• The **UCF** was introduced in the **Union Budget 2025–26** to support urban transformation in India.
 
• It emphasizes the need for **innovative urban planning**, addressing issues such as unplanned urbanization, lack of infrastructure, and environmental degradation.
 
• The fund encourages states to adopt **sustainable practices** and integrate technology into urban governance.
 
 
 
• **Features of UCF:**
 
 
• A total allocation of **₹1 lakh crore** has been provided to incentivize urban local bodies and states.
 
• The fund supports projects such as **smart cities, waste management systems, renewable energy projects, affordable housing,** and urban transport systems.
 
• It aims to improve **urban resilience**, ensuring cities are better prepared for challenges such as climate change impacts and population growth.
 
 
 
• **Government’s Vision for Urban Development:**
 
 
• The UCF aligns with the government’s broader vision of **urban transformation**, focusing on sustainable and inclusive growth.
 
• Projects under this fund will complement existing programs such as the **Smart Cities Mission** and **AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation).**
 
• It also focuses on enhancing **urban mobility** through initiatives like metro rail expansion and electric vehicles for public transportation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Objectives of UCF:**

 
 
• To promote **innovation** in urban development and governance.
 
• To ensure the adoption of **smart technologies** for efficient urban management.
 
• To address challenges such as urban sprawl, lack of infrastructure, and pollution.
 
 
 
• **Relation to Other Programs:**
 
 
• The UCF complements government schemes like the **Smart Cities Mission**, **AMRUT**, and **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**.
 
• It works alongside initiatives for **affordable housing**, waste management, and water supply improvement.
 
 

9b:T2a
